title: Online Orders Delivery Timetable by Service
content:
Business days for Online Orders are Monday to Friday, excluding US federal holidays. Each delivery service runs to the timetable below.

| Delivery service | Carrier and service | Order cut-off (Eastern Time) | Processing (business days) | Transit, fewest (business days) | Transit, most (business days) | Delivery date guaranteed | Saturday delivery |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Economy Ground | USPS Ground Advantage | 23:59 | 1 | 5 | 8 | No | Yes |
| Pickup Point Delivery | UPS Access Point Economy | 23:59 | 1 | 3 | 6 | No | No |
| Standard Ground | UPS Ground | 23:59 | 1 | 3 | 5 | No | No |
| Expedited 2-Day | UPS 2nd Day Air | 14:00 | 0 | 2 | 2 | Yes | No |
| Next Business Day | UPS Next Day Air Saver | 14:00 | 0 | 1 | 1 | Yes | No |
| Same-Day Courier | Roadie Same-Day | 11:00 | 0 | 0 | 0 | Yes | Yes |

## Reading the timetable

- **Order cut-off** is the latest Eastern Time at which an order placed on a business day counts as placed that day for dispatch. Same-Day Courier is offered only for an order placed by 11:00 Eastern Time.
- **Processing** is the number of business days between placement (after the cut-off rules) and dispatch. A figure of 0 means the order is due to leave on the day it counts as placed.
- **Transit, fewest** is the fewest business days the parcel spends in transit after dispatch.
- **Transit, most** is the most business days in transit after dispatch; the promised delivery date is the dispatch date plus this many business days.
- **Delivery date guaranteed** states whether the promised delivery date is guaranteed. Delivery Claims reads this column for late-delivery claims.
- **Saturday delivery** states whether the service delivers on Saturdays.

## Points of reference

- The three services with a guaranteed date (Expedited 2-Day, Next Business Day and Same-Day Courier) are also the three with no processing days.
- Economy Ground has the widest transit range on the Online Orders menu, from 5 to 8 business days; Standard Ground runs from 3 to 5, and Pickup Point Delivery from 3 to 6.
- Same-Day Courier shows 0 transit days: its delivery falls on the day of dispatch.
